coordinates: Rows 1–14 top to bottom, columns 1–10 left to right
assumptions: Keys and diamonds bounce the ball, as confirmed. Keys are collected on contact; diamonds break only after all coloured blocks are cleared.
The single key opens the single lock.
Par is a target only, not a loss timer.
A restart action is needed to recover from an incorrect colour commitment without a skull.

levels.name: First Bounce
levels.hint: Clear the blue blocks, then collect every diamond.
levels.teaches: Steer while bouncing; diamonds wait until all coloured blocks are gone.
levels.solution: Clear the lower blue shelves, weave through the middle shelves, then finish the upper pair. Return for both diamonds once the blue blocks are gone.
levels.safeRoute: Use broad outside arcs between shelves; there are no hazards or paint pots.
levels.fastRoute: Cut through the central gaps and aim each rebound toward the next shelf; missed angles only cost time.

levels.name: Stepping Stones
levels.hint: Grey breaks in any colour. Make your own gaps.
levels.teaches: Breakable grey shelves create temporary bounce surfaces and openings.
levels.solution: Use the lower grey shelf to change your route, then clear the blue pockets across the field. Grey blocks may remain when you take the two diamonds.
levels.safeRoute: Approach shelves from their wide outer ends and clear grey blocks when they obstruct an approach.
levels.fastRoute: Leave useful grey bounce surfaces intact and thread their ends to reach blue targets sooner.

levels.name: A Change of Colour
levels.hint: Finish every blue block before touching red paint.
levels.teaches: Painting is a commitment: blue cannot be restored without losing a life.
levels.solution: Clear all seven blue blocks while staying out of the lower-right paint alcove. Enter the red pot, work back up the red shelves, then collect both diamonds.
levels.safeRoute: Keep to the left and centre until blue is cleared; enter the paint lane deliberately from above.
levels.fastRoute: Finish blue at row 11, column 6 and turn toward the pot immediately, saving a traversal.

levels.name: Thorn in the Path
levels.hint: Give the skull room. Paint only after blue is clear.
levels.teaches: Route around a single hazard without sacrificing colour order.
levels.solution: Clear blue on the left and lower centre, staying wide of the central skull. Paint red in the lower-right corner, clear the right-hand targets, then revisit the diamonds.
levels.safeRoute: Cross between halves below row 10 or above row 4; pass the skull in the far-left or far-right lanes.
levels.fastRoute: Use the central opening beside the skull to shorten the crossing; this requires earlier steering.

levels.name: Garden Circuit
levels.hint: Blue first, then red, then green.
levels.teaches: Plan a three-colour route and avoid a later paint pot until it is useful.
levels.solution: Clear blue in the left lane, take red at the lower right, then clear red as you climb. Take green at the upper right and clear the central green targets before the diamonds.
levels.safeRoute: Use the broad left lane for blue and stay below the upper green pot until red is complete.
levels.fastRoute: Finish red on its upper shelf and turn directly into green, then sweep down the central targets.

levels.name: Golden Detour
levels.hint: Clear blue, then take the gold paint on the right.
levels.teaches: Choose a wide safe detour or a shorter route near a hazard.
levels.solution: Clear blue around the left end of the stone shelf, then take gold at the lower right. Clear the gold targets on the right and finish both diamonds.
levels.safeRoute: Pass left of the permanent shelf and use columns 8–10 to travel past the skull.
levels.fastRoute: Cut through column 7 between the shelf and the skull; set the steering direction well before row 7.

levels.name: The Garden Gate
levels.hint: Take the key to open a route through the stone shelf.
levels.teaches: A key creates a reusable shortcut; outer lanes remain an escape route.
levels.solution: Collect the key in the lower chamber and clear blue on both sides of the stone shelf. Paint red, use the opened gate or the outer lane to reach the upper red targets, then collect the diamonds.
levels.safeRoute: Use the three-column right passage around the shelf; the two-column left passage is also open.
levels.fastRoute: Use the one-cell gate after unlocking it. Centre the ball before crossing; the 0.6-cell ball has only 0.2-cell clearance per side.

levels.name: Ruins in Bloom
levels.hint: Blue, red, green, gold — then the diamonds.
levels.teaches: Combine colour planning, a gate and one avoidable skull in a full-field route.
levels.solution: Collect the key and clear all blue, then paint red at the lower right and clear red. Paint green at the upper right, clear its three targets, cross the upper field to gold at the far left, then clear gold and all three diamonds.
levels.safeRoute: Use the opened gate to change chambers and pass the skull through the central corridor. Enter each paint corner only when its preceding colour is complete.
levels.fastRoute: Use column 9 beside the skull and approach each next paint pot immediately after the final matching target; narrow clearances save distance but raise risk.

confirmedRules: Paint pots persist and can be reused. The ball dips inside, changes to the pot colour, and bounces back out; it never passes through.

paintPotBehaviour.routeImpact: Plan entry and exit around a rebound, not a through-route.
paintPotBehaviour.playtestStatus: Existing grids retained; safe and fast routes and pars must be validated with this confirmed bounce behaviour.
paintPotBehaviour.unspecified: Entry aperture, side/underside collision response and dip animation duration are not yet specified.
